text: Tidal guardians are huge, wormlike creatures found in Nazjatar. During the period following the Third War, Illidan's Naga used stationary tidal guardians as defensive structures able to spit lightning at enemies.
Tidal Loop was the final reward from the Hydraxis quest chain.
Tides of Darkness is a novel by Aaron Rosenberg focusing on the events of Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.

__NOTOC__ The Tidus Stair is an interesting rock formation that has the form of several terraces forming a giant set of stone stairs overlooking part of the Merchant Coast. It is located southeast of Ratchet, on the coast of the Northern Barrens. A pair of tauren, Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer, sit and fish and converse with water spirits there.
Tiev Mordune is a jungle troll quest giver located on North Tide's Run, west of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Tide Crawlers are blue crabs found along the coast of Darkshore prior to the Cataclysm.

Tier 4 is a type of item set. Each set consist of 5 pieces. Each piece is purchased by acquiring a "Fallen" armor token from defeating a The Burning Crusade raid boss. Each token is good for one piece of armor (chest, head, etc.), and is valid for any of several particular classes. Note that as this was created before death knights, monks, and demon hunters were available, there are no tier 4 armor sets for these classes.

Note that as this was created before death knights, monks, and demon hunters were available, there are no tier 5 sets for these classes.

.]] Tide Razor was a frigate belonging to the Southsea Freebooters, a legion of pirates who run their operations along the southeastern coast of Kalimdor. Rogues of the Horde had to enter Tide Razor and battle a fierce parrot as part of one of their many class quests. The Tide Razor has disappeared and been replaced by an Alliance ship, The Bellipotent. It is possible that the Alliance struck against the pirate's position for strategic purposes.

The bosses in the tier 5 raid instances Serpentshrine Cavern and The Eye drop class-specific trinkets. Some of the trinkets are appropriate for all specs of the class, but some are only good for specific specs.
__NOTOC__ Tiger Lily is a herb that can be gathered by Herbalism.

Tier 7 is a type of item set. Each set consists of 5 pieces. Separate 10-man and 25-man versions of each set exist, sometimes referred to by players as "tier 7.10" and "tier 7.25" (or "tier 7.5") respectively. 10-man sets are all prefixed with "Heroes'", and 25-man sets are all prefixed with "Valorous". Items from both sub-sets count towards the same set bonuses. The Heroes rank of tier 7 are item level 200. The Valorous rank are item level 213.

Tidal Waves is a Restoration shaman talent. It causes your Riptide to grant a buff that reduces the cast time of Healing Wave and Chain Heal, and increase the critical strike chance of Healing Surge. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

Tier 8 sets are 5-item, class-specific sets that can be acquired by raiding Ulduar. Separate 10-man and 25-man versions of each set exist, sometimes referred to by players as "tier 8.10" and "tier 8.25" (or "tier 8" and "tier 8.5") respectively. 10-man sets are all prefixed with "Valorous", while 25-man sets are all prefixed with "Conqueror's". No matter which level of tier 8 is worn, all pieces count toward the same set bonuses.
Tidewater Glades are a series of glades which have much treasure, but also much danger. While admiring the view, pay attention for any ambushes. The tileset is called "Ashenvale".

Tier 9 is the armor set associated with the Crusaders' Coliseum, which was released in patch 3.2. Awarded by the Argent Crusade, tier 9 is designed to ready players for the crusade's eventual march on Icecrown Citadel. __TOC__ Each set consists of five pieces. Like tier 7 and tier 8, there are two levels of tier 9: *____ of Conquest: item level 232, purchased with gold. *____ of Triumph: item level 245, purchased with Trophy of the Crusade from 25-player mode (all bosses) and gold. No matter which level of tier 9 is worn, all pieces count toward the same set bonuses. Each faction has their own flavor of the items, they are functionally identical, but have different artwork and names.
The Tidewalker tribe is a tribe of murlocs found in the Serpentshrine Cavern within Coilfang Reservoir in Zangarmarsh. They are commanded by Morogrim Tidewalker, a sea giant.
Tier 10 is the armor set associated with Icecrown Citadel, which was released in patch 3.3.0.
Tier 8 raid armor tokens are designated "Wayward". All are dropped from bosses in Ulduar.
Tier 7 raid armor tokens are designated "Lost". All are dropped from bosses in Naxxramas and Obsidian Sanctum.
Tier 6 raid armor tokens are designated "Forgotten". All are dropped from bosses in Battle for Mount Hyjal, Black Temple, and Sunwell Plateau.
Tier 5 raid armor tokens are designated "Vanquished". All are dropped from bosses in Serpentshrine Cavern, and The Eye in Tempest Keep.
Tier 4 raid armor tokens are designated "Fallen". All are dropped from bosses in Karazhan, Gruul's Lair and Magtheridon's Lair.
Tight-Fitting Leather Leggings are a quest reward from Rolling with my Homies.
Tier 3 raid armor tokens are designated "Desecrated." All were dropped from bosses in the original version of Naxxramas.
Tier 11 is the armor set associated with Bastion of Twilight and Blackwing Descent raids, which were released in patch 4.0.3a.
Tier 12 is the armor set associated with the Firelands raid. Like tier 11, there is a normal and a heroic version of each set.

Tier 13 is the armor set associated with Patch 4.3.0. Unlike tier 11 and tier 12, this tier is not available for Valor Points due to the implementation of Raid Finder. Tier 13 is obtained from bosses 2-6 in the Dragon Soul raid.
Tier 12 raid armor tokens are designated "Fiery". All are dropped from bosses in Firelands.
Tiger's Lust is a monk class talent. It is automatically learned by Brewmaster monks.

Tigers' Wood is a large forest located just south of the Path of Enlightenment in northwestern Jade Forest. The area has several roaming tigers, along with an unnamed cave where their alpha, Kher Shan, resides. Several Alliance paratroopers, led by Captain Jack Arrow, are dropping in at this site and attacking the local hozen.

Tideview Thicket is a forest found in north-central Jade Forest, just west of the Terrace of Ten Thunders. The forest lies on a cliff overlooking the South Seas. Owen's Wishing Well can be found by the north edge of the thicket. The forest is populated with wild eagles, black tigers, and an occasionally roaming mogu.

Tier 14 is the armor set associated with the launch of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria in Patch 5.0.4. It is obtained from the Terrace of the Endless Spring and the Heart of Fear raids. All the tokens are turned in to Commander Oxheart at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.
Tiger Temple Spectators are pandaren located in the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit. They also appear cheering during The Voice of Thunder.

__NOTOC__ The Tidestriker Adept is one of the four Pearlfin jinyu that appear during Bigger Fish to Fry (quest), following the player in order to train in battle. This trainee shows promise in the art of stabbing, and they wield daggers, which the player gave to them in A Perfect Match. They level up when they defeat something.

The Tidesages (also written tidesages), also known as sea priests or tidepriests, are a religious Kul Tiran group that worship the Tidemother based in Stormsong Valley, in the Shrine of the Storm. Most people on Kul Tiras look to the seas for guidance the same way others look to the Light, but the tidesages have a much deeper connection with the water. The tidesages were led by Lord Stormsong and had a leading council beneath him, each overseeing a different aspect of the order's work. Recently, however, Lord Stormsong, his inner circle and most of his followers have turned to the Void. Timbermaw Hold is a reputation faction of Timbermaw furbolg within the tunnels of Timbermaw Hold. Only if someone proves themselves by driving back the corrupted Deadwood tribe and Winterfall tribe, may they one day consider them as an ally. Only allies are allowed to pass freely through the tunnel.

Tigule is the inventor of ice cream and specifically the world-famous :Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream. He seemingly used to live in or near Southshore; Nat Pagle knew him and considered him a "loud-mouthed ruffian". According to a prophetic dream had by Pagle, Tigule eventually became rich off of his strawberry ice cream but later quit the business to become an adventurer, traveling "all over the place" before disappearing into a portal.

Timberlings are mobile plants that live in swamps or alongside rivers or lakes. They can be found in Teldrassil and the Swamp of Sorrows. The timberlings of Teldrassil are elementals of nature. In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on Teldrassil, but they have become corrupted and aggressive due to Fel Moss. Two notable timberlings of Teldrassil are Oakenscowl and Blackmoss the Fetid. In World of Warcraft, these creatures are classified as elementals.

The tigon is a creature resembling a humanoid big cat, so far primarily seen in the form of troll priests taking on the aspect of the feline loa Shirvallah and Bethekk. By the time of the war against the Iron Horde, troll druids had created a way for all druids to take on a half-cat form like those of Shirvallah's champions through the Claws of Shirvallah. This was later removed from the game.
Tigor Skychaser was a tauren shaman trainer located on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. Following Cairne's death, he was killed by the Grimtotem tribe.
Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream is the most famous ice cream on Azeroth and a favorite treat of kids everywhere!

The Timbermaw tribe of furbolgs inhabit two areas: Azshara and Felwood. They are presumed to be the only furbolg tribe to escape demonic corruption, though this may not be true due to the existence of Krolg, an uncorrupted furbolg who was once part of the Foulweald tribe, and the Stillpine tribe on Azuremyst Isle from The Burning Crusade. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolgs trust very few.
__NOTOC__ Timber is a rare wolf that can be found near the eastern side of Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh.

Timbermaw Post is a small furbolg camp located southeast across the road from the Frostfire Hot Springs, and west of Lake Kel'Theril. Although the name suggests that the camp was originally held by the Timbermaw tribe, it is now in complete control the corrupted furbolgs of the Winterfall tribe.
Time to Strike is a Horde quest in Hillsbrad Foothills. It is a simple delivery quest meant to move the player from the border of Silverpine Forest and Hillsbrad to Tarren Mill.

Timber Wolves were wolf mobs that could be found in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. After a sudden surge in their population, Eagan Peltskinner had put a bounty on the Timber Wolves and Young Wolves of Northshire, asking adventurers to thin their numbers and bring him their meat to cook. In the time leading up to the Cataclysm, these wolves contracted a mysterious illness that wouldn't go away.
